description: Use this when someone wants to browse WonderKit's public multi-day itineraries and place guides, for all cities or one city and audience. Plans that are in season this month come first. Each summary has dayCount (days or themed sections) and stopCount (anchors plus backups; before 2026-09-28 stopCount held the day count). Browses by city and audience only; it does not rank by a free-text description. Does not book or edit a trip.

audience.description: Who the plan is for: families, friends, or couples.

city.description: City name or WonderKit city key, such as "Paris" or "paris-france".

name: list_itineraries

found.description: false when the lookup did not resolve

dayCount.description: Days, or themed sections on a places-guide

inSeason.description: Whether the plan fits the month or season it was ranked for

lastReviewed.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the venues and copy were last re-checked

lede.description: One-line promise of the plan, as its page leads with

peakMonths.description: 1-12, when the page has a real peak

window.description: Human-readable best window, e.g. "Peak colour late Sep – mid Oct"

stopCount.description: Named stops (anchors plus backups) across the plan: the "N stops" the page shows. Not the day count; use dayCount for that. Until 2026-09-28 this field wrongly carried the day count, so a client that cached it as days should re-read

matches.description: Candidate cities when the name is ambiguous

nearest.description: Covered cities in or near the asked-for area. Not the city that was asked for

url.description: The WonderKit page for this city

why.description: Why this city is offered, e.g. "in Vermont" or "near Wyoming"

planDescription.description: One line saying what planUrl opens

planUrl.description: Guest planner link for the destination as asked; it plans any city

reason.description: unknown_city, region_not_city, no_city_guide, no_itineraries_for_city, ambiguous_city, no_published_guide, no_matches, unknown_itinerary, lookup_failed, …

region.description: The state, country, or area the city ask was read as

suggestions.description: Near-miss spellings, or same-name cities elsewhere, when the name is unknown

title: List itineraries
